meta.purpose: Observations against which the 3D model can be checked beyond the six MWRD pumping stations in data/mwrd-ps-cso-activity.csv.
meta.cso: MWRD CSO Event Synopsis Report, https://apps.mwrd.org/csoreports/ - per-outfall tide-gate open/close by waterway reach. Earliest date 2016-04-01, so only the 2017 and 2020 storms are covered. Only days with a CSO are listed, so an empty in-coverage window is a recorded absence.
meta.tarp: Reversals to Lake Michigan, hand-curated into data/storm-reports.csv with the verbatim MWRD table row as the quote for every figure.
meta.complaints: Chicago 311 "Water in Basement Complaint" and "Water On Street Complaint", https://data.cityofchicago.org/d/v6vf-nfxy. These request types begin 2018-12-19, so only 2020-05-14 of the ten storms is covered; the city publishes no pre-2019 311 water dataset.
meta.caveat: null means not found, never zero. Coverage differs per source and per storm; read the coverage flags before comparing storms with each other.
